title: Indexing System Setup Prompt
purpose: Reusable prompt and schema for building and maintaining accessible topic-to-lesson indexes for each language curriculum.
source_of_truth: Maintained Markdown lessons and SUMMARY.md; never index generated book output.

entry_schema.term: Canonical term, keyword, API, tool, or task
entry_schema.category: setup | syntax | types | operators | input-output | control-flow | collections | functions | OOP | files | errors | modules | testing | projects | accessibility | tooling | concurrency
entry_schema.lesson_path: Repository-relative Markdown path; optional verified anchor

prompt: Inspect repository tree and SUMMARY.md before editing. Maintained Markdown lessons are the source of truth.
Maintain one INDEX.md at each configured language path. Organize by practical topic headings and include learner-friendly search terms.

Inspect every lesson's headings, examples, exercises, and project requirements. Index concepts actually taught, including syntax, keywords, built-ins, standard APIs, tools, diagnostics, accessibility workflows, and project tasks.
For each entry provide a canonical term, useful aliases and beginner search phrases, and the most specific lesson page that explains it.
Verify every target exists. Add heading anchors only after verifying the heading and mdBook-compatible slug; otherwise link to the page without an anchor.
Link to the shared glossary where useful. Do not duplicate long glossary definitions in every index.

Keep language concepts distinct: Python None; JavaScript null and undefined; Java String equals versus ==; JavaScript Map versus Object; TypeScript compile-time checks versus runtime validation; Kotlin nullable types.
Include setup terms: runtime/JDK, compiler, package manager, terminal, editor, virtual environment, module system, and test runner.

Use semantic headings, simple Markdown tables or lists, descriptive links, and logical reading order. Do not use icon-only links, color-only meaning, visual-only instructions, scripts, or custom HTML widgets.
Update SUMMARY.md so each language index appears under its curriculum. Add a Backmatter section linking the glossary. The JSON prompt is a maintenance artifact and need not be rendered as a chapter.
Keep mdBook full-text search enabled. Curated indexes supplement search with topic-to-lesson navigation; they do not replace it.
Ensure every unit in each language has at least one index entry. Remove stale entries and add entries for new topics.
Do not alter lesson content merely to create an index. Propose glossary additions separately when needed.
Validate every relative link and anchor. Build mdBook and resolve malformed Markdown or broken links before committing.
maintenance_triggers: New setup workflow, exercise, project, or accessibility practice introduced
Python package-management workflow or recommended editor options changed
quality_checks: Every unit appears in at least one index entry.
Every link resolves and every anchor is verified.
No invented topics or nonexistent targets.
Each index links to its curriculum README and glossary section.
Indexes work with screen readers and keyboard navigation.
search_note: Keep mdBook built-in search enabled in book.toml. It indexes rendered chapter text; curated indexes provide organized topic navigation.
